gamla_ylva.name: Old Ylva
gamla_ylva.default_line: Stay close to the fire, child. The dark is listening.

bror_vakt.name: Bror
bror_vakt.default_line: No one passes without leave. Not even you.

sigrun_helare.name: Sigrun
sigrun_helare.default_line: Sit. I will tend your wounds before they tend to you.

gravvaktaren_ebbe.name: Ebbe
gravvaktaren_ebbe.default_line: The graves grow restless at night. I keep them still.

marta_torghandlare.name: Märta
marta_torghandlare.default_line: Everything has a price. Sometimes two.

gunnar_jarnhand.name: Gunnar
gunnar_jarnhand.default_line: Steel must hold. People too, if they are allowed.

olle_vardshus.name: Olle
olle_vardshus.default_line: The warmth is faint but honest. Drink before you go.

sara_benlasare.name: Sara
sara_benlasare.default_line: Bones tell truths people do not want to hear.

vaktkapten_ingrid.name: Ingrid
vaktkapten_ingrid.default_line: The guards remain even when hope runs.
